1. an act of administration.
2. a form of government.
3. = πολιτεία,
(a) citizenship: (R, txt.);
(b) community, commonwealth: (R, mg.; for exx. v. MM, xx).†

G4136.as:
*† πληροφορία, -ας, ἡ (< πληροφορέω),
full assurance, confidence: ; τ. συνέσεως, ; τ. ἐλπίδος, ; πίστεως, (cf. Lft. on ; M, Th., 9).†

G4140.as:
πλησμονή, -ῆς, ἡ (< πίμπλημι), [in LXX chiefly for שׂבע and cognate forms;]
a filling up, satiety: πρὸς π. σαρκός (RV, against the indulgence of the flesh; but ICC, in l., for the full satisfaction of the flesh, op. cit., 276 ff.), .†

G4146.as:
* πλουσίως, adv.,
richly, abundantly: , , , .†

G4192.as:
πόνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for עָמָל, etc.;]
1. labour, toil: .
2. The consequence of toil, distress, suffering, pain (Xen., al., LXX): , .†
SYN.: v.s. κόπος.

G4117.as:
** πλέγμα, -τος, τό (< πλέκω), [in Aq., Th.: Is 28:5*;]
what is woven or twisted (as basket-work, nets, etc.); a braiding (sc. τριχῶν, cf. ): pl., .†

G4131.as:
** πλήκτης, -ου, ὁ (< πλήσσω), [in Sm.: Ps 34 (35):15*;]
a striker, brawler: , (Arist., Plut., al.).†

G4104.as:
πιστόω, -ῶ (< πιστός), [in LXX chiefly for אמן ni.;]
to make trustworthy (Thuc., III Ki 1:36), hence, to establish (I Ch 17:14). Pass. and mid., to be assured of: c. acc. rei, .†

G4181.as:
*† πολυμερῶς, adv. (< πολύς, μέρος),
in many parts or portions: (Plut., al.).†

G4187.as:
** πολυτρόπως, adv. (< πολύτροπος, 1. much turning. 2. manifold), [in LXX: IV Mac 3:21 A*;]
in many ways or manners: (Philo).†

G4170.as:
πολεμέω, -ῶ (< πόλεμος), [in LXX chiefly for לחם ni.;]
to make war, fight: ; seq. μετά (II Ki 21:15 and v. M, Pr., 106, 247), ; hyperb., of private quarrels, .†

G4184.as:
*† πολύσπλαγχνος, -ον (< πολύς, σπλάγχνον),
very pitiful: .†

G4112.as:
* πλαστός, -ή, -όν (< πλάσσω),
1. formed, moulded (Hes., Plat., al.).
2. Metaph., made up, fabricated, feigned (Hdt., Xen., al.): .†

G4107.as:
πλανήτης, -ου, ὁ (< πλανάω), [in LXX: Ho 9:17 (נדד)*;]
= πλάνης, a wanderer: ἀστέρες π. (cl. planets), wandering stars, (WH, mg., -τες).†

G4158.as:
ποδήρης, -ες (< πούς), [in LXX: Ex 25:6 (7) 35:9 (חֹשֶׁן), 28:4 29:5 (מְעִיל), 28:27 (31) (אֵפוֹד), Ez 9:2, 3, 11 (בַּד), Za 3:5 (4) (מַחֲלָצוֹת), Wi 18:24, Si 27:8 45:8*;]
reaching to the feet: of a garment (sc. χιτών, cf. Ex 25:6 (7) 28:4, 27 (31) 29:5 35:9, Ez 9:2, 3, 11; Xen., al.), (for -η, LT7 read -ην; v. M, Pr., 49).†
SYN.: στολή, v. Tr., Syn., § 1.

G4141.as:
πλήσσω, [in LXX chiefly for נכה hi., ho.;]
to strike, smite: pass., (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-πλήσσω).†
